image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a red bicycle disc brake assembly. The image features a perforated metal rotor (disc) with intricate cutouts, a bright red caliper housing mounted over the rotor, and a portion of a black bicycle tire and rim on the right. The background is a blurred gravel surface, indicating shallow depth of field.
